summary: Backend-only test iteration for cpa-service CpaPartyXmlParser + syncParties (server-side XML->cpa_party persistence). Added 12 focused JUnit tests for CpaPartyXmlParser (namespace-agnostic parsing, OIN validation, role/service extraction, skip rules, XXE protection, malformed XML fail-safe) and 5 Mockito tests for CpaService.create/update syncParties behavior (create populates parties, empty parsed list, full reconcile add/update/remove, empty list wipes all, unchanged=in-place). Re-ran existing CpaServiceUpdateTest (10) and CpaControllerUpdateTest (6). All 33 tests pass. Docker/Testcontainers unavailable in sandbox so CpaServiceIntegrationTest party-sync scenario was not executed - known restriction.
critical_code_review_comments: CpaPartyXmlParser.parsePartyInfo uses getElementsByTagNameNS('*', 'PartyId') via firstDescendant, which searches all descendants. For nested PartyInfo (unlikely in ebXML CPA v2.0 but theoretically possible) this could pick up a PartyId from a nested element. Acceptable for CPA v2.0 schema but worth documenting.

syncParties() Collectors.toMap() will throw IllegalStateException if the existing parties list somehow contains two rows with the same partyId (duplicate key). Given the DB unique constraint (cpa_id, party_id) this shouldn't happen, but a merge function (p1,p2)->p1 would be defensive.

PartyId 'type' attribute lookup uses unqualified getAttribute('type') - if a CPA XML uses a namespaced attribute like tp:type='...', partyIdType will be null. Real-world CPA v2.0 documents use unqualified 'type' so this is fine, but call it out.
